_comment: Per-page metadata. .github/scripts/ogcards.mjs renders a share card for each entry into media/og/, and each page's head points at it. Add a page here, rerun the generator, and paste the head block. /s/ is deliberately absent: shortlinks.mjs generates that page, and two generators cannot own one file.
author: Vi Ellis

/.title: Vi Ellis
/.desc: Vi Ellis, applied computer scientist, hardware product developer, and award-winning composer. Production AI agents on the Claude API, full-pipeline hardware, GDC-showcased game audio.

/apps/.title: Things you can play with
/apps/.card: Eleven built things, all live in the browser
/apps/.desc: A directory of the tools and toys Vi Ellis has shipped, from a browser 3D modeller to a drum play-along, all running without an install.

/cadence/.title: CADence
/cadence/.desc: A browser 3D modeller that makes professional-grade CAD as approachable as a toy. Every shape is an editable recipe of exact parameters, and it slices its own models for printing.

/perch/.title: Perch
/perch/.card: A gentler way to keep track of yourself
/perch/.desc: A gamified self-care tracker that rewards showing up rather than streaks you can break.

/ghostnote/.title: Ghost Note
/ghostnote/.card: Drop in a song, get a drum chart
/ghostnote/.desc: A free browser drum play-along. Drag in any audio file, onset detection writes an editable chart, then play it on a MIDI kit.

/anim/.title: Layerloop
/anim/.desc: A browser tool for pixel animation with layers, frames and states, built for game art that has to react.

/resume/.title: Résumé Studio
/resume/.card: Build a résumé from a career library
/resume/.desc: A no-install résumé editor. Import your career history, tag it by skill and industry, then tick boxes to build a tailored résumé. Nothing leaves your browser.

/primes/.title: Primes
/primes/.card: A fractal grown from prime numbers
/primes/.desc: A generative L-system by Vi Ellis that grows a recursive fractal out of the distribution of prime numbers. Featured in Dezeen.

/datavis/.title: Sound of Data
/datavis/.desc: A generative sketch by Vi Ellis that turns a dataset into sound and motion, drawn live in the browser.

/chatbot/.title: Chatbot
/chatbot/.desc: An early conversational interface experiment by Vi Ellis, kept online as it was built.

/hp/.title: HACKING PARADISE
/hp/.desc: A media-arts collective for makers who find the unexpected route. We build, we ship, and we climb together.

/legoset/.title: Legoset
/legoset/.desc: Legoset, a collective. Music, radio and merch.

/resume.html.title: Vi Ellis
/resume.html.desc: The one-page résumé for Vi Ellis: applied AI, hardware product development, and award-winning composition.

/emanuel/.title: Emanuel
/emanuel/.desc: A looping desert scene. Rows of robed figures stand in the dusk, each wearing a pale mask painted with a teardrop, while the sand keeps drifting past them.
